assertion.rationale: F1: data-api's external boundary (ingressExternal: true) has no inbound authentication, so the estate's external communications boundary is neither monitored nor controlled for anyone who discovers the FQDN. F1 is NOT closed; it is Task 6, pending. F2: mcp-tools' external boundary is required to stay open (Copilot Studio calls it from the internet); the auth gate meant to protect that boundary was inert in the shipped configuration, so the control the repo advertises most prominently at its key internal/external boundary was not actually enforced. F2 is now CLOSED (Tasks 4 and 5). Task 4 closed the application half: enforcement no longer keys off backendMode, so the gate now fails closed at this boundary by default in every mode, and is mounted ahead of the body parser so an unauthenticated caller cannot make the process do work before the boundary check runs. Task 5 closed the infra half: MLS_TOOL_BACKENDS is now set explicitly (mcpToolsBackendMode, default 'local') rather than being absent, and the token the boundary check compares against is resolved from the platform Key Vault at runtime via the mcp-tools UAMI's Key Vault Secrets User grant (keyVaultUrl reference, infra/bicep/apps/main.bicep module mcpKvGrant) rather than depending on an operator remembering to wire a secure parameter through infra/ or CI that nothing ever did. The boundary that must legitimately stay external (mcp-tools) is now actually protected by a token that is guaranteed to be present rather than merely possible. Overall status stays GAP: data-api's external boundary (F1) remains completely unauthenticated and unaddressed by this task.

recommendation: Set ingressExternal:false on data-api so it is no longer an external boundary at all. (The MCP auth gate default and Key Vault token resolution recommended here previously, for mcp-tools' boundary, are DONE — Tasks 4 and 5.)
